description: Adversarial: polite, non-urgent gift-card request from a claimed executive (no urgency or secrecy cues).

email.subject: Client appreciation
email.body_text:
Hope your week is going well.
When you have a moment, no rush at all, could you purchase a few Apple gift cards for our client appreciation event?
Please send me the card codes when done and I will reimburse you.
Thank you so much.
